question: As per the provisional figures of the 2011 census, the literacy rate has registered an increase of ____ percentage points since 2001.
solution:
The correct answer is **__9.21__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **literacy rate** in India increased from **64.8%** **in 2001** to **74.01% in 2011 (increase of 9.21%)**, according to Census data.
 
• The **male literacy rate** increased from** 75.26% in 2001** to **82.14% in 2011**, while the **female literacy rate **increased from **53.67% in 2001** to **65.46% in 2011**.
 
• The** gap between male and female literacy rates** decreased from **21.59% in 2001** to **16.68% in 2011**, indicating a narrowing gender disparity in literacy.
 
• The states of **Kerala, Mizoram, and Tripura** had the **highest literacy rates in 2011,** while **Bihar, Arunachal Pradesh, and Rajasthan **had the **lowest literacy rates**.
 
• The increase in literacy rates can be attributed to** various government initiatives and programs **aimed at promoting **education and literacy**, such as the** Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan and the National Literacy Mission**.
 
• **Higher levels of education and awareness**, as well as improvements in infrastructure and access to educational facilities, have also contributed to the increase in literacy rates.
 
• The Census data on literacy rates is crucial for **policymakers and educators** to **assess the progress of literacy** **initiatives and plan** for future interventions to further improve literacy levels in India.
